about:
Hyper-Layering Architecture (HLA) is an open architecture for combining independent content, data, and services on the Web through geographic space.

Hyper-Layered Map (HLMap) is a Web map viewer based on HLA. In autumn 2026, SVGMap was renamed HLMap to reflect the broader Hyper-Layering concept.

With HLA, each layer can be an independent source of content, data, or services. Instead of relying solely on information aggregated by a portal, users can freely choose and combine different sources and layers directly in their browser.

HLA is not merely a concept. It is a proven foundation technology that has been used for many years to integrate more than 200 Web-based systems as map layers.
